_comment: Captured from a real run against the Cashfree sandbox on 2026-08-31 using @cashfreepayments/agent-toolkit@1.1.0. Every id, amount and latency is measured, not invented. The derived stats below were recomputed on 2026-09-01; if you change any latency, recompute them.

toolCatalog._note: Counted from getAgentTools().length and the tool names, NOT from the package README, which implies 41.

latencyStats._note: 64ms is the FASTEST call (getAllRefunds), not a typical one. Do not describe it as typical.
